rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a verbal account or portrayal of something.

example.english: This report gives a detailed description of what happened in the accident.
example.traditional: 呢份報告對事故經過有詳細描述。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 deoi3 si6 gu3 ging1 gwo3 jau5 coeng4 sai3 miu4 seot6

rows.note: Use this when “description” means a type or category rather than a verbal account.

example.english: Tea can be divided into many types, and this description refers to one of them.
example.traditional: 茶可以分好多種類，呢個描述就係其中一種。
example.jyutping: caa4 ho2 ji5 fan1 hou2 do1 zung2 leoi6 ni1 go3 miu4 seot6 zau6 hai6 kei4 zung1 jat1 zung2
